name: Chrome Hearts Black Leather Fleur Knee Pants
basis_of_authenticity: Dealer listing: sold as authentic by Savonches. No outside legit check; the basis is the dealer only.
model: Black calf leather (tag) fleur knee pants, straight fit, button fly. Pre-owned (dealer).
what_the_tags_read: Leather label: embossed scroll, CHROME HEARTS in gothic letters; under it a short gothic line, not fully legible in the photo. Stitched all round.
Tab under the label: small, damaged or folded, no text legible.
Size tag: two CHROME HEARTS scrolls, "29", "170 / 80B".
Composition tag: "BODY: LEATHER: CALF / LINING: 100% COTTON"; "CORPS: CUIR: VEAU / CUIR: 100% COTON" (as printed); Japanese, Korean, Chinese; "MADE IN U.S.A.".

White printed care tag: five care symbols, "PROFESSIONAL LEATHER DRY CLEAN ONLY", "NETTOYAGE À SEC PROFESSIONNEL DU CUIR UNIQUEMENT", then Japanese, Korean and Chinese lines; CHROME HEARTS scroll sideways on the facing tag.
Lining: black fabric with tone-on-tone Chrome Hearts emblems.
